description: This is a extension package for LiveMarkdown.Avalonia that adds support for rendering Mermaid diagrams.
releaseNotes:
v2.5.0 replaces CSharpMath with [RaTeX](https://github.com/Sylinko/RaTeX.Net) for LaTeX rendering, and moves cross-block text selection into state shared per selection scope, so every renderer in a scope agrees on what is selected and whether it can be copied.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> The `LiveMarkdown.Avalonia.Math` package now renders formulas with RaTeX.Avalonia 1.0.0 and no longer depends on `Sylinko.CSharpMath.Avalonia`. Node registration, `$...$` / `$$...$$` syntax, style classes and the error-style selectors are unchanged, but formulas are laid out by a different engine, so expect visual differences.

## Highlights

### LaTeX rendering moves to RaTeX

- `MathInlineNode` and `MathBlockNode` now share a `MathPresenter` that parses and lays out with `Ratex.TryParseAndLayout` and draws through RaTeX's `FormulaControl`; existing node registration code needs no changes.
- Missing glyphs (CJK, emoji, other fallback scripts) are measured with Avalonia's font manager after the first layout pass and laid out again, so fallback text keeps its native position instead of being placed with estimated metrics.
- Default-colored formulas follow the surrounding `Foreground` and light/dark theme switches, while explicit `\textcolor{...}` / `{\color{...} ...}` — including mid-expression — keep the color they ask for.
- Inline formulas inherit the surrounding font size (headings, nested spans) and take their baseline from the rendered formula; display formulas keep their own size.
- When parsing or layout fails, the source text replaces the previous formula, the `Error` class is applied, and the message is exposed as a tooltip; a partially streamed formula recovers on the next update.

### Selection state shared per scope

- A new internal `MarkdownSelectionScope` owns the selection for one scope root: range calculation, the drag snapshot, and the `CanCopy` flag live there, and `MarkdownRenderer` delegates to it instead of keeping a private copy.
- `CanCopy` is published once per scope, so after any renderer in an `IsSelectionScope` container changes the selection the other renderers update too, and a menu bound to any of them stays correct.
- The platform Select All gesture (`Ctrl+A`) now selects the whole visible scope. It was previously marked handled without selecting anything.
- Renderers join, leave and re-parent scopes as the visual tree changes; removing a renderer, clearing the document or hiding a branch drops the selection it contributed instead of leaving `CanCopy` stuck on.
- A drag is cancelled when the blocks it selected are removed or hidden, so a stale snapshot can no longer overwrite the selection.
- `MarkdownTextBlock` now raises `ContextRequested` itself after its renderer handles the input, so a flyout attached closer to the text can bind `Copy` / `SelectAll` directly.
- State synchronization no longer rescans the visual tree per update: with 5,000 unrelated blocks and 2,000 updates, it went from ~306 ms to ~0.04 ms, with zero allocations on the new path (state-sync stage only).

### Demo and docs

- The demo context flyout gains a **Select All** item next to **Copy** and opens at the pointer.
- The LaTeX sample now covers RaTeX rendering: delimiters, CJK/emoji fallback, explicit and scoped colors, LaTeX font sizes, heading size inheritance, baseline alignment and wrapping, matrices and multiline layout.
- README documents the shared `CanCopy` behavior and scope-wide Select All / Copy.

## Compatibility

- The public selection API is unchanged: `SelectedText`, `CanCopy`, `SelectAll()`, `ClearSelection()` and the compatibility shim `SelectionScopeName` behave as before, now over the shared scope.
- The Math package no longer depends on `Sylinko.CSharpMath.Avalonia`; styles written against CSharpMath's `MathView` no longer apply. The documented selectors (`MarkdownTextBlock.Math`, `MarkdownTextBlock.MathBlock`, `.Error`) are unchanged.
- Remove any direct `Sylinko.CSharpMath.Avalonia` reference from your app; no Math node API changed.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/DearVa/LiveMarkdown.Avalonia/compare/v2.4.3...v2.5.0
